duel.chronicle.won.spared: {fighter} bested {opponent} in single combat and let them walk away with their life.
duel.chronicle.won.yielded: {opponent} begged quarter of {fighter} and was granted it.
duel.chronicle.won.captured: {fighter} beat {opponent} down and took them captive for ransom.
duel.chronicle.lost.spared: {opponent} bested {fighter} in single combat, but spared them.
duel.chronicle.lost.yielded: {fighter} yielded to {opponent} and was granted quarter.
duel.chronicle.lost.killed: {fighter} fell to {opponent} in a duel to the death.
duel.chronicle.lost.captured: {opponent} beat {fighter} down and led them away in chains.
duel.notify.won.spared: You beat {opponent} and spared them. (Renown {renown, number, ::sign-always})
duel.notify.won.killed: {opponent} is dead by your hand. (Renown {renown, number, ::sign-always})
duel.notify.lost.spared: {opponent} beat {fighter}, but let them live. (Renown {renown, number, ::sign-always})
duel.notify.practice: A good bout in the practice yard against {opponent}.
duel.notify.declined: You refused the challenge. Tongues will wag. (Renown {renown, number, ::sign-always})
duel.notify.cancelled: The duel did not take place.
duel.tell.highStrike.0: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} eyes flick to your helm.
duel.tell.highStrike.1: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} blade rises past the shoulder.
duel.tell.highStrike.2: {sex, select, female {She lifts her elbow} male {He lifts his elbow} other {They lift an elbow}}, measuring the height of your guard.
duel.tell.lowStrike.0: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} weight sinks onto the front knee.
duel.tell.lowStrike.1: {sex, select, female {She watches} male {He watches} other {They watch}} your feet, not your face.
duel.tell.lowStrike.2: The point of {sex, select, female {her} male {his} other {their}} blade drops toward your shins.
duel.tell.guardHigh.0: {sex, select, female {She tucks her chin} male {He tucks his chin} other {They tuck their chin}} behind the shield rim.
duel.tell.guardHigh.1: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} shield creeps up toward the brow.
duel.tell.guardHigh.2: {sex, select, female {She settles back} male {He settles back} other {They settle back}}, guarding the head.
duel.tell.guardLow.0: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} shield drifts down to cover the thighs.
duel.tell.guardLow.1: {sex, select, female {She crouches} male {He crouches} other {They crouch}}, shield angled low.
duel.tell.guardLow.2: {sex, select, female {She sets her feet} male {He sets his feet} other {They set their feet}} wide and lowers the guard.
duel.tell.bash.0: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} weight shifts to the back foot, shield squared to you.
duel.tell.bash.1: {sex, select, female {She drives her shoulder} male {He drives his shoulder} other {They drive a shoulder}} in behind the boss.
duel.tell.bash.2: {sex, select, female {She grips} male {He grips} other {They grip}} the shield handle hard, knuckles white.
duel.tell.feint.0: A smile tugs at the corner of {sex, select, female {her} male {his} other {their}} mouth.
duel.tell.feint.1: {sex, select, female {She looks one way and leans} male {He looks one way and leans} other {They look one way and lean}} the other.
duel.tell.feint.2: {sex, select, female {Her} male {His} other {Their}} blade twitches, too eager to be honest.
duel.prompt.title: Single combat
duel.prompt.lethal: This duel is to the death.
duel.prompt.gentle: Gentle Mode: if you fall, you will be taken captive rather than killed.
duel.weaponSpecial.sword: Every third blow in a row strikes harder.
duel.weaponSpecial.axe: A heavy blow on a shield hooks it aside: no blocking for a moment.
duel.weaponSpecial.spear: Longer reach; thrusts pierce part of the foe's armour.
duel.weaponSpecial.daneAxe: No shield. Hews shields apart twice as fast; a committed swing is not stopped by a flinch.
duel.weaponSpecial.hammer: Crushes through half of the foe's armour; blows may stagger.
